description: This file defines the EmployeeSupervisorAPI class, which serves as a REST API endpoint for managing employee supervisor relationships within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting supervisor records for specific employees, utilizing various services and models. The file also contains API documentation annotations for Swagger/OpenAPI.

classes.name: EmployeeSupervisorAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing employee supervisor relationships, providing operations like get, list, create, update, and delete supervisors for employees, with integrated validation and OpenAPI documentation annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee supervisor record by employee number and supervisor ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all supervisors associated with a particular employee, supporting pagination and sorting.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new supervisor record for an employee with specified reporting method.

methods.name: setSupervisorParams
methods.description: Populates a ReportTo entity with parameters from request payload.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing supervisor record with a new reporting method.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more supervisor records for an employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single supervisor record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing supervisors.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a supervisor record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting supervisor records.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a supervisor record.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Validation rule ensuring employee number is accessible.

methods.name: getReportingMethodIdRule
methods.description: Validation rule ensuring reporting method ID is positive.

methods.name: getSupervisorIdsRule
methods.description: Validation rule ensuring supervisor IDs are provided as an array.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts employee number and supervisor ID from URL parameters for use in methods.
